title: CoreWeave Enters India With 240 MW AI Data Centers at Adani Campus

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The AI cloud-computing provider has secured capacity at the AdaniConneX facility in Navi Mumbai for its first foray into the Indian market. CoreWeave will initially deploy 240 MW of AI data center power and holds an option to increase terms to 480 MW, with the first facilities scheduled to become operational in mid-2028.

The venture with the Adani Group is part of CoreWeave's broader expansion across Asia. The agreement allows the company to secure energy allocations immediately while deferring the choice of GPU hardware generation until closer to the launch date to align with India's AI infrastructure development.
